sku_type.notes: Identity column of uht.uht_dict (there is no sku_type_complete column here). Verified 1690/1694 rows equal TRIM(CONCAT(sub_brand,' ',rasa,' ',kemasan)). Skip any null/empty source when composing.

keywords.notes: keywords == sku_type exactly on 963/1694 rows; the rest are sku_type followed by space-separated common misspellings/aliases (the same tokens stored in keyword_typo). When minting with no typos, set keywords = sku_type and keyword_typo = '' (empty string, never NULL).

kemasan.notes: '<volume:int> <units>' plus ' x <pcs:int> pcs' when pcs > 1. Verified 1671/1694.

_table_notes.no_meta_column: uht_dict has NO _meta column - do not try to stamp _meta on dict inserts here.
_table_notes.filter_table_schema: uht.filter_uht_tokopedia has columns ecommerce, product_id, sku_name, merchant_id, _meta - there is NO reason column.
_table_notes.qa_table_schema: uht.product_id_dict_qa: url, ecommerce_platform, product_id, keywords, sku_type_complete, brand, sku_name, unnamed:_7, _meta.
_table_notes.packsize_buckets: Mini (0 - 125 ml) / Small (126 - 200 ml) / Medium (201 - 899 ml) / Large (900 - 1000 ml) / Extra Large (1000 - 5000 ml) - bucket on UNIT volume, not carton total.
